items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 29 August 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A low pressure centre lies over southern England today.


##Wind##

Mainly east or northeast, backing north or northwest this evening, 2 to 4, then becoming south or southwest 3 or 4 overnight. Backing south or southeast 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain at first, then showers overnight. Then occasional rain or showers tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, gradually veering west overnight into Monday. Increasing west or northwest 5 or 6 Monday morning, then decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate for a time later.


##Weather##

Showers or longer spells of rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain.
